value.rationale: Right spine is an intrinsic search-tree shape feature and precisely the input permutation record count; internal path length is the cost of constructing the BST. Their finite mixed moment is not fixed by known marginals. Exact sign, a new linear limiting covariance, vanishing correlation with sharp constant, and the derivative of expected construction cost with respect to record bias provide nonroutine quantitative dependence and a model-sensitivity benchmark. No downstream joint limit law is claimed.
